title: A Theory-guided Weighted $L^2$ Loss for solving the BGK model via Physics-informed neural networks
abstract: arXiv:2604.04971v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: While Physics-Informed Neural Networks offer a promising framework for solving partial differential equations, the standard $L^2$ loss formulation is fundamentally insufficient when applied to the Bhatnagar-Gross-Krook (BGK) model. Specifically, simply minimizing the standard loss does not guarantee accurate predictions of the macroscopic moments, causing the approximate solutions to fail in capturing the true physical solution. To overcome this limitation, we introduce a velocity-weighted $L^2$ loss function designed to effectively penalize errors in the high-velocity regions. By establishing a stability estimate for the proposed approach, we shows that minimizing the proposed weighted loss guarantees the convergence of the approximate solution. Also, numerical experiments demonstrate that employing this weighted PINN loss leads to superior accuracy and robustness across various benchmarks compared to the standard approach.

translated_title: 一种理论指导的加权 $L^2$ 损失函数：用于通过物理信息神经网络求解BGK模型
translated_abstract: 尽管物理信息神经网络为求解偏微分方程提供了一个有前景的框架，但标准的 $L^2$ 损失形式在应用于Bhatnagar-Gross-Krook（BGK）模型时存在根本性的不足。具体而言，仅最小化标准损失并不能保证对宏观矩的准确预测，导致近似解无法捕捉真实的物理解。为了克服这一局限性，我们引入了一种速度加权的 $L^2$ 损失函数，旨在有效惩罚高速度区域的误差。通过为所提出的方法建立稳定性估计，我们证明了最小化所提出的加权损失可以保证近似解的收敛性。此外，数值实验表明，与标准方法相比，采用这种加权PINN损失在各种基准测试中均能带来更优的精度和鲁棒性。
tldr: 本文提出一种理论指导的速度加权 $L^2$ 损失函数用于PINN求解BGK模型，通过稳定性估计证明该加权损失可保证宏观矩的收敛，并在数值实验中展现出优于标准方法的精度与鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a theory-guided velocity-weighted $L^2$ loss for solving the BGK model with physics-informed neural networks, proves via stability estimates that minimizing this weighted loss guarantees convergence of the approximate solution, and demonstrates superior accuracy and robustness over the standard approach.
